def factor_lower_shadow_volume_weighted(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    candle_min = np.minimum(df_copy["open"], df_copy["close"])
    lower_shadow = candle_min - df_copy["low"]
    vol_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / vol_ma.replace(0, np.nan)
    weighted_shadow = lower_shadow * vol_ratio
    signal = weighted_shadow.ewm(span=5, adjust=False).mean()
    df_copy["factor_lower_shadow_volume_weighted"] = signal.fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_lower_shadow_volume_weighted"]
description: Captures buying pressure at the lows using the lower shadow (distance from min(open, close) to low). A large lower shadow indicates that buyers stepped in aggressively near the day's low, often a precursor to a bullish reversal. Volume weighting amplifies the signal when the session was active, and a 5-day EMA smooths the measure. Cross-sectional ranking identifies stocks with the most pronounced relative buying pressure.
